Class PostGISCopyInsertBatch

java.lang.Object
nl.b3p.brmo.sql.PostGISCopyInsertBatch
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, QueryBatch
public class PostGISCopyInsertBatch extends Object implements QueryBatch
The PostgreSQL JDBC driver does not support parallel copy operations, even with multiple connections. So this class can cache the copy stream in memory so only one copy operation is active at a time, although this is significantly slower.
